sentences.text: V.Suresh vs State Of Ap on 31 December, 2019

Author: C.Praveen Kumar
Bench: C.Praveen Kumar
 The Honourable Sri Justice C.Praveen Kumar
 Criminal Petition No.5840 of 2019
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.254 of 2019, dated 22.08.2019, on the file of Addanki Police Station, Prakasam District.
The offences alleged are under Sections 188 and 273 I.P.C. and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner so also the learned Public Prosecutor submits that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the common order, dated 18.12.2019, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch.
He placed on record copy of the said order.

4. Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the common order passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, following the said order and in terms thereof, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/accused in F.I.R.No.254 of 2019,
dated 22.08.2019, on the file of Addanki Police Station, Prakasam District are hereby quashed.
5. Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 18.12.2019, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch to this order.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
_______________________________ JUSTICE C.PRAVEEN KUMAR Date : 31.12.2019 AMD THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE C.PRAVEEN KUMAR CRIMINAL PETITION No.5840 of 2019 Date : 31.12.2019 AMD V.Suresh vs State Of Ap on 31 December, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167575923/
